nodes.label: Admin 404 cross-subdomain login bug
nodes.rationale: Login at barraca.jurmaq.cl pushed router to /admin within subdomain causing 404; fix uses absolute window.location to cross domains.

nodes.label: Domain=.jurmaq.cl cookie sharing fix
nodes.rationale: NextAuth cookie scoped to single host wouldn't travel across subdomains; switch to Domain=.jurmaq.cl plus __Secure-prefixed name for cross-subdomain session.

nodes.label: Invalid Date fix in solicitudes
nodes.rationale: Page used legacy field names not present in DB schema; aligned interface and renderer with DB columns (cliente_nombre, created_at, maquinaria_nombre).
